title: SCons ignores compilation flags
body: ### Tested versions latest master branch commit (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/b13043816a0f234985030ec035363a005bc86c32) ### System information wsl2 (ubuntu 26) on wondows 11 (16 threads 20GB ram) ### Issue description scons ignores some flags, which is why it searches for libraries that don't exist (I use build flags to remove XR/VR completely) **something is being completed and something is giving an error**: > [ 99%] Ranlib Library bin/obj/modules/freetype/libfreetype_builtin.windows.template_release.x86_64.llvm.a ... > [ 99%] Linking Static Library bin/obj/core/libcore.windows.template_release.x86_64.llvm.a ... > Ranlib Library bin/obj/core/libcore.windows.template_release.x86_64.llvm.a ... > [ 99%] Linking Program bin/godot.windows.template_release.x86_64.llvm.exe ... > [ 99%] > [ 99%] Linking Program bin/godot.windows.template_release.x86_64.llvm.console.exe ... > [ 99%] scons: done building targets. > INFO: Time elapsed: 00:07:35.62 > scons: Reading SConscript files ... > Using linker program: mold > Package openxr was not found in the pkg-config search path. > Perhaps you should add the directory containing `openxr.pc' > to the PKG_CONFIG_PATH environment variable > Package 'openxr' not found > OSError: 'pkg-config openxr --cflags --libs' exited 1: > File "/root/godot/SConstruct", line 732: > detect.configure(env) > File "/root/godot/platform/linuxbsd/detect.py", line 337: > env.ParseConfig("pkg-config openxr --cflags --libs") > File "/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/SCons/Environment.py", line 1808: > return function(self, self.backtick(command), unique) > File "/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/SCons/Environment.py", line 793: > raise OSError(f'{command!r} exited {cp.returncode}') > root@DESKTOP-0MJ1PMI:/godot# > root@DESKTOP-0MJ1PMI:/godot# https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b13043816a0f234985030ec035363a005bc86c32/platform/linuxbsd/detect.py#L336 ### Steps to reproduce ``` sudo apt update && sudo apt full-upgrade -y ``` ``` sudo apt install -y scons pkg-config clang mold gettext \ libx11-dev libxcursor-dev libxinerama-dev libxi-dev libxrandr-dev \ libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev libasound2-dev libpulse-dev ``` ``` wget https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/download/20260922/llvm-mingw-20260922-ucrt-ubuntu-22.04-x86_64.tar.xz sudo mkdir -p /opt/llvm-mingw sudo tar xf llvm-mingw-*.tar.xz -C /opt/llvm-mingw --strip-components=1 rm llvm-mingw-*.tar.xz cd ~ && git clone https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git && cd godot ``` ``` cat > build.sh <<'EOF' #!/usr/bin/env bash set -e export PATH=/opt/llvm-mingw/bin:$PATH export MINGW_PREFIX=/opt/llvm-mingw export SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY="8c74e225dd263c6c3fd740b78b2c067052edb4f1ae991a33b16caf9372b6b754" (!!! for test, dont used) FLAGS="optimize=size_extra lto=full deprecated=no \ forward_plus_renderer=yes forward_mobile_renderer=no opengl3=no d3d12=no \ accesskit=no angle=no engine_update_check=no disable_xr=yes \ builtin_openxr=no module_mobile_vr_enabled=no module_openxr_enabled=no \ module_visionos_xr_enabled=no module_webxr_enabled=no" for T in editor template_debug template_release; do scons platform=windows arch=x86_64 target=$T use_mingw=yes use_llvm=yes $FLAGS -j$(nproc) done for T in template_debug template_release; do scons platform=linuxbsd arch=x86_64 target=$T use_llvm=yes linker=mold $FLAGS -j$(nproc) done ls -lh bin/ EOF ``` ``` chmod +x build.sh && ./build.sh ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
